author: Primal Space
description:
Water, water everywhere… and Venice couldn’t drink it.

After deliveries of fresh water from the mainland couldn’t meet demand, engineers got to work utilizing the existing squares in the city. The perfect materials had to be chosen, like clay for waterproofing, filling in with sand for permeation, stone for the wells and topping with tile to direct flow. Gutters were also added to the houses. All of this to collect nature’s source of fresh water - rain.
title: The Genius Venetian Water System
